content: Pɔl kàler làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl a tɔŋtɔŋ, waa kàtɛn naa: « Atɔŋ abaal, yà unsà an'kyän a duu mɛ kàsyääl Nzam tii ŋàbawà. »
Wɛɛ Undweer a ngaŋ Ananyas kàswɛŋ baar bàkäl tsütsü apà nde mukun'kam mbar u mun ande.
Pɔl kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ubwaŋ a nsà, Nzam ayapà mbar! Ngye an'bwaay mukan'tsüül nsaŋ unsà un'kɔɔn, wɛɛ ngye, ngye awàmubɛy un'kɔɔn, ngye aswaŋ baar ban'käm mbar! »
Baar bàkäl tsütsü apà nde bàtɛn a nde naa: « Ngye awàmuto undweer a angaŋ a Nzam! »
Pɔl kàtɛn naa: « Atɔŋ, mɛ in'yayöb anki naa nde wà undweer a angaŋ, ntɔn bàsön naa: "Ngye asun'to anki mfum a un'sɛŋ angye!" »

Pɔl kàkyer ayöb naa Làbay a Nsaŋ a kölàköl làkäl an'kab mɔ̈ɔ̈l: ndam yà Asadusi, ndam yà Amfarisi. Lalan kàkuub nde in'kwɛŋ kusà a ba: « Atɔŋ abaal, mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'mfarisi, mwan a amfarisi. Ntɔn làkyän unsà ngwiiyà a akü, ba bàman'sà u làbay a nsaŋ. »
Pa kàmay nde mutɛn, mbaaŋ yàbü uboo a Amfarisi anà Asadusi, lalan nköŋ yàkaabà ya.
Ntɔn Asadusi bàfàtɛn naa itàkal ngwiiyà kà ukwà, itàkal un'kyeey, itàkal dweelà batɛy, wɛɛ Amfarisi bàfàkyey naa ba bà mwo.

In'kwɛŋ myàkyer asöönà mbɔɔn, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn amwɛy uboo a Amfarisi waa bàmbarà, bàtɛn a ngwal naa: « Bi akà ndaa mwɛy yà ube imanà anki unsà mbuur wà. Taaŋ lumwɛy dweelà làmwɛy akɔ̈ɔ̈n sye un'kyeey mwɛy kun'kyään ndaa! »
Mbaaŋ yàbulà yà ngwal. Ntɔn bɔɔmà muman naa ba ban'kwo musay Pɔl, mfum a nsaab kàswɛŋ aŋità ande mutyà anà mukun'lwom uboo a ba anà mukun'syen u fɔrtɛrɛs.
U mpib yàlääb paa, Mwol kàyàmɛnà akà Pɔl, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Tsim! Ngye an'tà imbäl amɛ apà u Yɛlusàlɛm, ngye akyer afàkàtà sye u Lɔmà. »
Ndiirà ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ a Pɔl
Taaŋtyà, Ayudà bàkyer adirà, waa bàdi kyän naa ba bàdyà anki anà bànwà anki tii mpal bàsàdwa ba Pɔl.
Baar bàdirà ndaa ayi bàkäl aŋàsöön ankweem an'nà.
Apan, ba bàkàman amfum a angaŋ anà andweer, waa bàtɛn naa: « Bi kan'bɔl un'kaan anà kan'dyà kyän naa bi undiir idyà anki kusà mudwa Pɔl.

Wɛɛ akà bɛ apanà, mbwo mwɛy anà Làbay a Nsaŋ a Kölàköl, làkyen kàlalɔ̈m mfum a aŋità naa nde kàlatwääl awà asànaa bɛ làkwen mulab ndaa ande pànsi pànsi. Wɛɛ bi, bi indiir byanswà ikyàlɔn ntɔn mukun'dwa kusà nde muyàkɔlà apà. »
Wɛɛ mwanàmpääŋ a Pɔl wàbaal kàwem ndiirà ayi, nde kàkyen fɔrtɛrɛs, waa kàbilà ntɔn mukyään Pɔl naa nde ukäl kà igyɛɛŋ.
Pɔl kàbel umwɛy uboo a aŋità, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Lun'syen mwan baal wà akà mfum a aŋità ntɔn nde we anà ndaa mukun'kyään. »
Kaptɛn awà kàsyen mwan baal awun akà mfum a nsaab, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mbuur a bɔlokà Pɔl akyer an'bel, waa kan'lɔ̈ɔ̈m mukatwääl mwan baal wà awe anà undiir akakyään. »
Mfum a nsaab kàtɛ mwan baal awun mpi u kɔɔ, kun'syen u mpey, waa kun'fuul naa: « Ininà ngye awe awà mukan'kyään? »
Nde kun'fuur naa: « Ayudà ban'lwɛɛŋ naa ba bàyàlɔm akà ngye naa ngye asyen Pɔl nkàswo u Làbay a Nsaŋ a Kölàköl asànaa ba bàkwen ulab ndaa ande pànsi pànsi.

Wɛɛ ngye, ngye twɔn amakyey, ntɔn aŋàsöön baar an'kwem an'nà uboo a ba bàkun'diil ndɔɔŋ u mbwo. Ba bàdi kyän naa ba bàdyà anki anà bànwà anki tii mpal bàyun'dwa ba. Ba ndaa yanswà ban'yöŋà, yan'sal nkyeey angye mpɛl. »
Apan mfum a nsaab kàfuur mwan baal awun ungö akun'swaŋ naa: « Twɔn an'kyään akà mbuur mwɛy naa mɛ an'yöb ndaa ayi. »
Pɔl akà mfum Filikisi

Ungö apan, mfum a nsaab kàbel baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a an'kaptɛn, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làsɔ̈ɔ̈l aŋità nkam yweel, asyeen a mpoonà an'kwem nsambwaar anà aŋanwɛŋ nkam yweel, ntɔn u taaŋ làwà là mpib ba bàkyà Sɛzarɛ.
Làlɔ̈ɔ̈n sye mpoonà ntɔn musyen Pɔl ntɔn nde ukàtol unsà ubwaŋ banswà akà kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r Filikisi. »
Apan, nde kàsön un'kaan abà:
« Kɔlɔdɛ Lizyasi akà mwol Filikisi, làköm angye!
Mbuur wà, Ayudà bakyer un'kɔr anà bàkyer alun'dwa. Mpal kàwem mɛ naa nde wà un'lɔmà, mɛ kàkyen anà aŋità ntɔn mukun'lwom kan'kɔɔ aba.
Mɛ kàkwen muyöb isin a ndaa bun'füün ba, lalan kun'syen mɛ kusà a Làbay a Nsaŋ a Kölàköl.
Mɛ, mɛ kàmɛn naa ba bun'füün ntɔn ndaa a un'kɔɔn aba, wɛɛ akà ube mwɛy kàkyer nde batɛy ntɔn bun'dwä itàkal bun'bäm in'siŋ.
Kan'wem mɛ sye naa Ayudà bàmulɛɛ untaam, lalà amatööm mɛ awà anà an'swaŋ mɛ baar bun'füün naa ba ŋakwo bun'füün akà ngye. »
Aŋità bàläb ndaa baswɛŋ, waa bàwɛl Pɔl, bun'syen u mpib u Antipatris.
Taaŋtyà, ba bàwɛy asyeen a mpoonà mulab mbwo anà Pɔl, waa bàfurà fɔrtɛrɛs.
Mpal bàtöl ba Sɛzarɛ, asyeen a mpoonà bàpɛ mfum un'kaan, waa bun'swɛŋ Pɔl sye.
Ungö kàtäŋ nde un'kaan, nde kàfuul naa Pɔl wà mbuur a itiir a nsi nà. Mpal kàwem nde naa nde wà mbuur a Silisi,
nde kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ in'yawem mpal bàyàyà sye baar bafüün. » Apan, nde kàswɛŋ naa bun'si u làpaŋ a Ɛlɔdi.
